title: Deep learning predicts tumor-specific vulnerabilities from loss-of-function screens
summary: A deep learning method trained on in vitro loss-of-function screens predicted tumor-specific vulnerabilities in patient samples. It nominated Ran GTPase nucleocytoplasmic transport as a vulnerability in Her2-positive breast cancers and Ku70/80 for tumors defective in homologous recombination. Experiments in patient-derived cells for Ran, Ku70/80 and a proteasome subunit showed they could be targeted specifically in the tumors predicted to depend on them.
ai_technology: Deep learning model trained on in vitro loss-of-function screening data

evidence.tested: Experimental validation of three predicted dependencies in patient-derived cells.
evidence.unknown: How many predictions were tested, the sample numbers and whether the targets work clinically; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Infers each tumor's dependencies from its mutations and expression using learned relationships from screens.
